# LCB Training

LCB Training (lcbtraining.com) is Coach Broc's baseball and softball training for youth, high school, and college players. Players get daily work in the app, personal swing feedback, and coaching between lessons.

## Who it is for
- Youth, high school, and college baseball and softball players
- Parents and coaches looking for structured practice between lessons
- Travel and club teams that want remote or in-person coaching support

## What is offered (current prices)
- Free swing breakdown: send a swing video for Coach Broc's written feedback
- Core membership: $10/mo (or $100/yr) - starter drills, starter workouts, starter guides, written swing report every 6 weeks, Daily Challenge
- Plus membership: $20/mo (or $200/yr) - full drill library, full workouts, guides + Playbook, monthly in-depth video review, messaging with Coach Broc
- All-Access membership: $249/mo - everything in Plus plus a personalized daily plan, weekly video review and check-in, monthly goals, game/practice logging, kickoff call, Recruiting Guide
- 12-Week Coaching Program: $599 one-time - same coaching as All-Access for 12 weeks
- The Next Level Playbook (standalone purchase available)
- Fix-It hitting plans, remote 1-on-1 sessions, and free sample resources
